message: The other night, we had a surprise power outage, and I had to chuckle a bit. I had just been bragging to my friends about my little stash of flashlights and power banks, and there I was, pulling them out like a superhero in the dark. It’s funny how those ‘just-in-case’ moments turn into the best reminders to stay prepared. I felt pretty smug when I was cozy with my lantern while my neighbors were fumbling around! Do you have a go-to backup plan for when the lights go out?
